sources.title: Electron beam welding
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: 金屬粉床熔融製程
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付半對數抽氣曲線、時間估算與漏氣待驗假說。；教學抽氣目標≤45 s，原模型失敗、加倍抽速通過；實際平台壓力另列未驗。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver semilog pumpdown, time estimate and leak hypotheses.; For a teaching pumpdown target≤45 s, the original fails and doubled speed passes; actual plateau pressure remains unverified.
related.difference: 由合成收縮率反算 CAD 補償尺寸，再確認單一縮放是否足以解釋各方向誤差。
related.differenceEn: Infer CAD compensation from synthetic shrinkage and test whether one scale explains all directions.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: Lfinal=Lcad(1−s)，因此 Lcad=Ltarget/(1−s)。；教學目標 Ltarget=40.00 mm，線性收縮率 s=0.005。；Lcad=40/(1−0.005)=40.201005 mm。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Ideal leak-free p=p0 exp(−St/V), so t=(V/S)ln(p0/pf).; Teaching V=0.10 m³, S=0.010 m³/s and p0/pf=1000, using only a pressure ratio.; t=(0.10/0.010)ln1000=69.0776 s.
Lfinal=Lcad(1−s), hence Lcad=Ltarget/(1−s).; Teaching target Ltarget=40.00 mm and linear shrinkage s=0.005.; Lcad=40/(1−0.005)=40.201005 mm.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 高壓壓鑄模具工程
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付半對數抽氣曲線、時間估算與漏氣待驗假說。；教學抽氣目標≤45 s，原模型失敗、加倍抽速通過；實際平台壓力另列未驗。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver semilog pumpdown, time estimate and leak hypotheses.; For a teaching pumpdown target≤45 s, the original fails and doubled speed passes; actual plateau pressure remains unverified.
related.difference: 辨認模腔壓力作用的投影面積與總表面積差異，建立鎖模力概念預算。
related.differenceEn: Distinguish pressure-projected area from total surface area and build a conceptual clamping-force budget.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 分模方向的分離力 F=pAprojected；複雜曲面的受力用方向投影，澆道投影也要列入。 純教學虛擬壓力 20 MPa，零件投影 0.020 m²、澆道 0.005 m²；不作機台設定。 F=20×10^6×0.025=500000 N=500 kN；若漏算澆道則僅 400 kN，低估 20%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Ideal leak-free p=p0 exp(−St/V), so t=(V/S)ln(p0/pf).; Teaching V=0.10 m³, S=0.010 m³/s and p0/pf=1000, using only a pressure ratio.; t=(0.10/0.010)ln1000=69.0776 s.

Opening force F=p Aprojected along the parting direction; include runner projection rather than total curved surface area. Purely educational virtual pressure 20 MPa; part projection 0.020 m² and runner projection 0.005 m²; not machine settings. F=20×10^6×0.025=500000 N=500 kN; omitting runners gives 400 kN, a 20% underestimate.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
